title: LA Peptides Brand Profile
description: Everything that identifies and styles ONE brand partner — set up once per brand, reused across every product/batch that brand sells. Combines with a product-profile.json (per product/batch) to render a finished label — see RENDERING-SPEC.md. Every property below maps to a specific master-label.svg element id or theme token; the exact mapping is implemented in scripts/lib/composeProfiles.js and is 1:1 with label-spec.json's field/theme registries.

brandProfileId.description: Stable identifier for this brand partner, e.g. "acme-wellness".

name.description: Brand name. -> brand_name (autofit: shrinks to fit if needed, see VALIDATION-RULES.md).

subtitle.description: Optional line under the brand name. -> brand_subtitle. Not in the original brand-asset list but supported since master-label.svg has a dedicated element for it. Fixed-width column, does not auto-shrink.

tagline.description: Short brand tagline next to the decorative accent graphic. -> brand_tagline. Auto-fit: shrinks font-size if longer than this — see VALIDATION-RULES.md.

primary.description: Relative path to the primary logo asset (.svg/.png/.jpg — see VALIDATION-RULES.md for format rules). Auto-scaled to fit its allotted box (layout.json -> brand_logo) preserving aspect ratio. -> brand_logo.

secondary.description: Optional secondary logo / certification badge. A symbol reference (e.g. "#icon-logo-secondary", the template's built-in seal) or a swapped-in asset path. Set null/omit to hide it. -> brand_logo_secondary.

decorativeGraphic.description: Optional decorative accent graphic next to the tagline. A symbol reference (e.g. "#icon-decorative") or a swapped-in asset path. -> brand_decorative_graphic.

heading.description: Brand/product name font stack. -> brand_name, product_name.

subheading.description: Optional; supporting-text font stack. Falls back to body if omitted. -> brand_subtitle, product_descriptor, purity_claim, lab_claim, qr_caption.

body.description: Package-wide default font stack for any text without a more specific font.

mono.description: Optional; tracking-block font stack. Falls back to body if omitted. -> lot_number, ubd, coa_url.

iconColor.description: Optional; colors purity_icon/lab_icon/country_icon/brand_logo_secondary. Defaults to accent if omitted.

icons.description: Optional custom icon graphics. Each is a symbol reference (e.g. "#icon-purity", one of the template's built-ins) or a swapped-in asset path. Omit either to keep the template default.

qrStyle.description: Brand-level default QR caption; a product-profile's own qrCaption (if set) overrides this per product.

countryGraphic.description: Country/region-of-origin graphic. A symbol reference (e.g. "#icon-origin", the template's generic pennant) or a swapped-in asset path. -> country_icon.
